submitted_sql: SELECT SUM(i.total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.billing_country = 'Australia';
validated_sql: SELECT SUM(i.total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice AS i JOIN public.customer AS c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.billing_country = 'Australia'
